newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy car market ranked 2nd in Europe again - Anfia.
newsitem.headline: Italy car market ranked 2nd in Europe again - Anfia.

text.p: Italy's car market, boosted by a government incentive scheme, is back in second place in Europe by size after Germany, a ranking Italy held during the boom years from 1989 to 1992, Italian carmakers' association Anfia said.
Official data on Monday showed Italian new car registrations rose 21.45 percent to 198,000 in February. Anfia said in a statement it forecast total 1997 sales of around two million vehicles.
In the first two months of this year, deliveries were 12.1 percent up at 361,346 reflecting the boost to the market given by the bonus scheme to scrap old cars for old.
But the full effects of the scheme introduced in January would only be really seen in March, Anfia said.

The positive prospects were also confirmed by the average increase in daily sales which rose 27.5 percent to 9,900 in February. Anfia noted that February this year had only 20 working days against 21 in the same month last year.
